content.value: . Consider a steam power plant operating on the ideal refrigerative Rankine cycle with one open feed water heater. Steam enters the turbine at 15 MPa and 600 C and is condensed in the condenser at a pressure of 10 KPa. Some steam leaves the turbine at a pressure of 1.2 MPa and enters the open feed water heater. Determine the fraction of steam extracted from the turbine and the thermal efficiency of the cycle.
